data.content: Plan: make src/machine.rs first-use persistence atomic via write-temp-then-hard_link (converge racers on the winner's re-read value on AlreadyExists), thread io::Result through machine_id/resolve_machine_id/persisted_machine_id and the ~9 existing callers (App::machine_id -> Result<String, AppError>, plus SyncError call sites), document (not change) the delete-and-regenerate behavior on no-system-id platforms, add a concurrency test proving N racing threads converge on one persisted id. Single-file core change (src/machine.rs) plus small Result-threading edits, no new files, no child knots.
